---
title: "GDSC2 Gemcitabine: RNA-seq Data Preparation"
output: html_document
---

This file describes the preprocessing for the planned Trans-GLM analysis. Pancreatic cancer is the target group; colorectal, gastric, non-small-cell lung, and ovarian cancers are candidate sources. The response is GDSC2 `LN_IC50` for gemcitabine and predictors are log2(TPM + 1) RNA-seq measurements.

## 1. Files and matching

The original files come from Cell Model Passports. `03_PrepareGDSC2.R` matches the `SANGER_MODEL_ID` in the GDSC2 spreadsheet with `model_id` in both the model list and the TPM matrix. The TPM matrix's first three rows are metadata and its fourth row is the gene header.

The following command rebuilds the cleaned CSV files if the three original downloads have been placed in `data/raw/`. It is not run automatically during knitting because the original RNA-seq file is large.

```{r eval=FALSE}
source("03_PrepareGDSC2.R")
```

## 2. Number of matched cell lines

```{r}
counts = read.csv("data/gdsc2_merge_counts.csv")
print(counts)
print(sum(counts$matched_tpm_models))
```

Four non-small-cell lung models have gemcitabine responses but no matching TPM column. They were excluded before gene filtering.

## 3. Select 2,000 genes

The filtering rules use external-source expression data only. A gene must have TPM greater than 1 in at least 20% of the 199 source samples (40 samples). The 2,000 genes with the largest source-sample variance in log2(TPM + 1) are retained. Genes with missing or invalid TPM values in the matched models are excluded.

```{r}
filter_counts = read.csv("data/gdsc2_gene_filter_counts.csv")
print(filter_counts)

selected_genes = read.csv("data/gdsc2_selected_genes.csv")
print(head(selected_genes[, c("gene_symbol", "ensembl_gene_id", "rank")]))
```

## 4. Check the modeling dataset

```{r}
cleaned = read.csv("data/gdsc2_gemcitabine_2000genes.csv", check.names = FALSE)

print(dim(cleaned))
print(table(cleaned$group))
print(sum(is.na(cleaned)))
print(range(cleaned$LN_IC50))
print(head(cleaned[, 1:7]))
```

```{r}
hist(cleaned$LN_IC50, main = "Gemcitabine response across matched cell lines",
     xlab = "LN_IC50")
boxplot(LN_IC50 ~ group, data = cleaned,
        main = "Gemcitabine response by cancer type",
        ylab = "LN_IC50", las = 2)
```

## 5. Status of analysis

This notebook completes the initial matching and feature selection, not the final Trans-GLM analysis. Model fitting and evaluation must use held-out pancreatic observations; any centering, scaling, or tuning based on target data must be performed inside the corresponding training fold. The fixed source-only gene filter should be applied identically to both transfer methods in the planned comparison.
